title: Signed to be a backup, Jacoby Brissett wants to be compensated as a starter

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Signed to be a backup, Jacoby Brissett wants to be compensated as a starter
sources.description: Last year, quarterback Jacoby Brissett signed a two-year, $12.5 million deal to serve as the backup to Kyler Murray.
